title: Do Employees Have Useful Information About Firms' ESG Practices?
eligible_reason: No staggered binary adoption DiD is estimated. The main analyses regress future ESG outcomes (f1.-f3. leads) on the employee inside-view measure with industry-by-year FE and controls (predictive regressions, OLS/ppmlhdfe/logit). The only DiD-type designs are: (i) a court-ruling difference-in-differences with treated circuit states versus control states and a single treatment year (global treat_year = 2013), estimated with firm FE, ff48-by-year FE and lagged time-varying controls (l_size l_roa l_n_reviews); (ii) a Business Roundtable (BRT) 2019 single-date comparison on PSM-matched firms using 2018-to-2020 changes; (iii) a UN Global Compact (UNGC) joining analysis that is staggered but collapsed to pre/post means on a PSM-matched sample and estimated as cross-sectional change regressions with industry FE, not TWFE. None satisfies the multiple-adoption-date TWFE requirements.
design_notes: Firm-year panel (mainpanel.dta, not shipped) of Glassdoor-covered firms, roughly 2008-2022, with ESG inside-view measures (E_net_p_wr_wf, S_net_p_wr_wf, G_net_p_wr_wf), MSCI KLD ratings, Compustat/CRSP variables, Climate Trace emissions, Audit Analytics, LSEG sentiment. 8analysis.do: predictive regressions with absorb(ff48#year) and cluster(glassdoorID) (lines 503-553, 611-616); BRT matching and change regressions (lines 646-772); UNGC PSM and pre/post change regressions (lines 799-941); D&I court-ruling DiD (lines 877-979) with treat_post, treat_post0-3, treat_pre2-3 and absorb(glassdoorID ff48##year), cluster(state).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Court-ruling DiD has one treatment year (2013); BRT has one date (2019); UNGC joining dates vary but the analysis is collapsed to pre/post averages on a matched sample.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (2013); lagged time-varying controls
specs.outcome: harassment_net_p_wr_wf (then E_net_p_wr_wf S_net_p_wr_wf G_net_p_wr_wf at line 978)
specs.treatment_var: treat_post = treat x post (post = year >= 2013); dynamic versions treat_post0-treat_post3, treat_pre2-treat_pre3
specs.treatment_definition: treat = firm headquartered in 2nd/4th/9th circuit states; post = year >= 2013
specs.sample_condition: treat non-missing (treated and control circuits only); year != 2013; year > 2009
specs.reported_location: unknown (likely an appendix or mechanism table)

specs.exclusion_reason: collapsed pre/post change regression on PSM-matched sample; industry FE only; not TWFE
specs.outcome: change_E change_S change_G (post minus pre averages of inside view)
specs.treatment_definition: firm joined the UN Global Compact in year _treated_year (staggered), matched controls
specs.sample_condition: PSM-matched sample (psmatch2, caliper 0.1, n(10)), years t-3..t-1 vs t+1..t+3

data_files: HT code final for MS/data/panel_ESG_inside_views.dta (firm-year ESG inside-view measures only)
HT code final for MS/data/wordlists 20250307 Final.xlsx (ESG dictionaries)
data_files_note: README: raw Glassdoor text, MSCI KLD, Compustat, CRSP, Audit Analytics and LSEG data cannot be redistributed; only the constructed inside-view measures and word lists are shipped. The regression panel mainpanel.dta is not included, so no regression in 8analysis.do can be run from the package. Logs of the original runs are included (logs/8analysis.txt).
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, ppmlhdfe, asdoc, psmatch2, matchit), Python (spaCy, gensim) for text processing, SAS for Compustat/CRSP pulls.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). The regression-extraction file only captured two logit lines; the full set of regressions was read from 8analysis.do. Full-text flags (ft_staggered, ft_goodman_bacon) likely come from the discussion of the UNGC/BRT analyses.
